name: Pixieset
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Pixieset, publish a simple password-protected client gallery from user-owned storage. The hard boundary is gallery hosting, proofing, downloads, store, mobile apps, and photographer workflow, plus image pipeline quality, models, and workflow polish.
